features.statement: Primary action buttons are real button elements with a solid green fill and text label.
Typography uses a single sans-serif family (Segoe UI) with slightly larger, looser body text.
Section headings use title or sentence case rather than all-caps.
Navigation is plain dark title-case text links with one item highlighted as a green tab.
Header is a full-width white bar with a smaller left-aligned logo and a banner image on the right.
Search input is a centred pill-shaped field with rounded green border beside a text submit button.
Suggested searches and social links appear as small pale-green pill chips.
Supporting call-to-action is a separate pink or coral filled pill button rather than inline text.
Content is grouped into separate white rounded cards sitting on a dark textured background.
Lists of entries render as a two-column grid of cards, with bold primary text and italic secondary text beneath.
Cards carry a coloured left-border accent, with green and blue distinguishing groups.
Card section headings are marked with a small green square or decorative icon image.
Pagination uses white rounded boxes with a green active page.
Statistics are shown as a grid of tiles with large numbers.
Language selector uses bordered chip buttons with the selected one highlighted light green.
Main column is wide, with a narrow card sidebar beside it.
Footer is white with a green top rule, link columns, and stacked illustrations at the bottom left.
Palette combines dark ink text with deep green, blue, pink and coral accents.
Flat styling with no shadows, gradients, animations or transforms; borders separate cards.
Images carry descriptive alt text, with empty alt on decorative icons.
Markup is lightweight and semantic: section elements, few divs, one script, compact custom class set, minimal meta tags.
Heading outline is shallow with no h1, and list entries are not headings.
Page title is short, title-case, with an en dash separator.
Microcopy is friendly and sentence-case, with spaced slashes and bold sign-off names.
Section headings are added for previously unlabeled blocks, such as a blog heading, with link colour in blue.
